title: First run: Welcome's Start or a connected cloud while the record cannot be read counts as a full record and finishes, so the questions never come back once the record reads
evidence: Done: fixed by PR 1608. From the owner's review of PR 1602. ios/HealthRoadmap/App/RootView.swift worked out needs from needsFlow, which was false when store.myData is nil, so an unread record looked full: S34's welcome x started(false) finished, set onboarded, and a relaunch with a readable record that lacks height opened on the tabs with no questions. Base (before S34) left onboarded false for Start; only Connected finished on base. A plain needs: myData == nil || needsQuestions guard would not have worked: with myData nil the questions case finishes at once (OnboardingView.begin sends began(nil) on an unreadable record, and the Color.clear arm with no Apple Health does the same), so it still set onboarded. Fix: needsFlow and needsQuestions are nil while the record is unread; Cover's started and connected carry needs: Bool?, and welcome x started(nil) or connected(nil) go to none with no effect, so welcomed is set and onboarded stays false. Cover.Launch.needsQuestions is Bool? too: the first launch that reads the record decides, the questions if it lacks sex, birth year or height, else deciding x launched (welcomed, not onboarded, needs false) finishes at launch, so saves count and the tour starts, once. That also finishes a phone left welcomed-but-not-onboarded with a full record before S34, once, on the first launch after the update (intended, S34). A launch with the record still unread finishes nothing. Until that launch, the unread session's saves do not count toward the backup offer. Pins: FirstRunTests table rows for both nil events and the launch rows, the persisted keys after started(nil), an unread Start then a record lacking height decides questions, and an unread Start then a full record finishes at the next launch once.
